verdict.rationale: Built-in AI insights are a fair capability to ask of a knowledge-base app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Logseq generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The docs cover queries, plugins, a local HTTP API and export, but none of these is shown to offer an AI feature. The one AI mention describes users driving Claude or Codex from outside Logseq to write pages, which is not in-product insight.
